notes: Example profile. Every field is optional; anything left out is worked out from the logs.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.what: Tornadoes fire out from the boss. Getting hit does big damage and stacks a DoT on you.
Tempest.todo: Watch the boss when the combo starts and step out of the tornado lines. Don't sidestep into someone else's lane.
fixes: Watch the boss when each tank combo starts and step out of the tornado lines. Don't sidestep into someone else's lane.
If a tornado clips you, press a healthstone or personal right away. The DoT is what kills you 10 seconds later, in the Fury stack.
Healers: top up Tempest-DoT targets before the Fury pop, not after.

Virulence.name: Serpent's Fury → Virulence
Virulence.what: A big circle lands on one player and 14 people must stand in it, or the boss builds rage toward an enrage. Everyone who soaked gets Virulence: when it expires it bursts in lines that spread it to anyone they hit.
Virulence.todo: Soak the circle, then go straight to the edge and spread out. Come into every stack healthy: if someone carrying Virulence dies in the stack, it bursts onto everyone around them.
fixes: Come into every Fury stack healthy. If you have a Tempest DoT or Surge on you, use a personal or healthstone before the pop.
Healers: the 5 seconds after the pop are for the Virulence carriers. Top them first.
Spread to your spot at the edge straight away so the lines don't clip anyone.

Venomous Surge.name: Venomous Surge
Venomous Surge.what: Several players get marked. When the debuff ends they leave a Viscous Cyst at their feet. The damage is lower the farther apart people are.
Venomous Surge.todo: Spread before it lands and use a personal if you're low. If you're marked, drop your Cyst opposite the marked wind tunnels so it's ready for the winds.

Viscous Cyst.name: Viscous Cyst
Viscous Cyst.what: Touching a Cyst pops it, knocking everyone back and slowing them. You need them to stay on the platform during the winds. They pop by themselves after 2 minutes.
Viscous Cyst.todo: Walk around Cysts, never through them, from Surge until the winds. Only pop one on purpose during a wind push.
fixes: Pre-assign Crosswinds partners every set. Paladins, Priests and Shamans have no reliable cancel, so pair them with someone who can collide with them, and have them call it.
Drop Surge Cysts on their markers, opposite the marked tunnels, and never in the lanes people fly down when Crosswinds goes off.
From the moment Surge lands until the winds, nobody walks over the Cyst spots. Path around them when you move for the next combo or stack.
In the winds, one called player pops each Cyst for its push. Nobody else touches one.

Raging Crosswinds.name: Raging Crosswinds
Raging Crosswinds.what: You get a circle with an arrow. A moment later you're knocked hard in the direction of the arrow.
Raging Crosswinds.todo: Find someone whose arrow points the opposite way and line up with them so the knocks cancel out. Stay away from people who aren't your partner.

Mutilate.name: Mutilate
Mutilate.what: A frontal cone the tank aims at the raid. It's a group soak: the damage is shared by everyone standing in it.
Mutilate.todo: Tanks aim it at the soak group. Soakers: be in your half and stacked before the second combo starts. It one-shots when too few people are in it.

Mutilated Gash.name: Mutilated Gash
Mutilated Gash.what: Not covered in the guides. Most of these deaths come 10 to 30 seconds after a Mutilate soak, so it looks like damage left over from soaking.
Mutilated Gash.todo: Treat it as a soak problem: alternate soak groups, and heal up or use a personal after you soak while low.

Ravage.name: Ravage
Ravage.what: A frontal cone on the tank that does massive damage and leaves a huge damage-taken debuff. It does not split.
Ravage.todo: Tanks aim it away from the raid and taunt when needed. Nobody else stands in front of the boss.

Caustic Claws.name: Caustic Claws
Caustic Claws.what: Circles show where venom will land. Getting hit hurts a lot, and it leaves a puddle behind.
Caustic Claws.todo: Step out of the circles and don't stand in the puddles.

Ula'tek's Presence.name: Ula'tek's Presence
Ula'tek's Presence.what: Passive rot damage on the whole raid for the entire fight. It finishes off anyone left low by something else.
Ula'tek's Presence.todo: If you're low, don't wait for a heal: healthstone, potion or personal.

fixes: After the third wind push, the bait and the soak group go straight to the stack. The first Fury after the winds has the least time to spare.
For the second Fury, stack on the timer, not when combo 2 ends. Late gives you this enrage, and early makes the post-winds Fury harder.
If the bait dies, Fury jumps to someone new. Call the new name and move to that circle immediately.
Enrage.todo: Get 14 into every circle. If the bait dies, Fury jumps to someone new: find the new circle fast.
